_note: Defender SOC config for the F2 federation detection task -- facts a real SOC legitimately holds about its OWN environment. NOT telemetry, NOT attacker-visible, NOT an oracle: these are the org's own IAM policy + IdP schema, exactly what a detection engineer references when writing a rule. A rule reads them via {"$config": <key>}. Per-instance: each generated instance ships its own soc_config (the honored tag key is per-instance -- see F2 idp/app.py TAG_NAME=_F.get(...)); this file is the fixed reference instance the grounded corpus was captured on.
honored_tag_note: the entitlement tag key this instance's IAM trust policy honors -- the aws:PrincipalTag/<TAG_NAME> condition gating privileged role assumption (cloudiam /iam/describe surfaces it to the attacker; the SOC holds it as its own policy).
self_service_attrs_note: the FIXED pool of self-service-editable source attributes (the IdP schema; F2 gen.py _SOURCE_ATTRS). A self-service attr that feeds the honored tag is the smuggle vector. All are editable -- there is no authoritative subset.
